sloka: यथा दृष्टिः शरीरस्य नित्यमेवप्रवर्तते ।तथा नरेन्द्रो राष्ट्रस्य प्रभवः सत्यधर्मयोः ॥२-६७-३३॥
transliteration: yathā dṛṣṭiḥ śarīrasya nityamevapravartate ।tathā narendro rāṣṭrasya prabhavaḥ satyadharmayoḥ ॥2-67-33॥

translations.english: The king is the source for protecting the truth and morality of a country like the eye which perpetually watches the welfare of the body.
